items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. Ed Christian. He played piano

ctx.x: Yeah. Ed Christian. He played piano, so he had a thing going with him, too. But Charlie was... He had a natural thing going. Cats used to come around and look for Charlie when they'd come to Oklahoma City. They wanted to show him like... Some cat Louis who played guitar with (what was that girl there?) Julia Lee, I think her name was, from Kansas City... He played in her band, and they would come to Oklahoma City to play dances.
